description: Post-quantum-ready cryptography library for Android and JVM. Wire-compatible with the SaQura .NET (NuGet) and Swift (SPM) packages — data encrypted in any of the three SDKs decrypts identically in the others. Surfaces: AES-256-GCM, RSA-4096 (OAEP encrypt + PSS sign), PBKDF2-SHA512 password hashing, FrodoKEM + Classic-McEliece + hybrid X25519/ML-KEM (FIPS 203) post-quantum KEM, ML-DSA (FIPS 204) and SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) signatures, constant-memory large-file streaming encryption (SQS1, AES-GCM / ChaCha20-Poly1305 + post-quantum envelope), offline license activation.
